# Bodyguiding

> Bodyguiding is an integrative approach that supports you in learning from your own body. Developed by physiotherapist Kamila Moravcová, it works with touch, movement and mindfulness and meets the body as a unique, living whole.

Kamila Moravcová has been in clinical practice since 2008 and holds a Master's degree in Physiotherapy from Charles University in Prague. Her work is shaped by the functional approach of Clara Lewitová and by studies in fascia, integral anatomy and biotensegrity. The website is available in English and Czech.

## Services

### Individual Bodyguiding
- **Price:** €200
- **Format:** Online, 100-minute session plus preparation and follow-up
- **For:** Anyone coming with pain, a specific question or simple curiosity
- **How it works:** Before: a short questionnaire. Together: 100 minutes online using conversation, guided movement and attentive observation. Afterwards: reflections and selected material to revisit and integrate into everyday life.

### Bodyguiding Intensive
- Individually guided process combining in-depth Bodyguiding sessions with shorter Guided Movement Explorations, individual practice, reflection and support between meetings.
- **Foundation:** 3 months, €1,800. A focused period with a more concentrated rhythm.
- **Continuum:** 6 months, €3,000. A slower, more spacious process.
- **How to start:** Free Introductory Call to explore which rhythm suits.

### Individual Co-Vision
- **Price:** €160
- **Format:** Online, 80 minutes (allow up to 90 minutes)
- **For:** Physiotherapists, movement teachers, bodyworkers and other practitioners
- **Details:** One-time or ongoing. Topic or question shared before the session. Students may enquire about individual pricing.

### Curious Spaces (workshops and shared learning)
- For practitioners and anyone interested in a deeper relationship with the living body. Themes range from biotensegrity and clinical practice to movement and the relationship with ourselves.
- **Availability:** Individual workshops available again from April 2027. Early booking recommended.
- Custom workshops can be co-created on request.

### Free Introductory Call
- **Price:** Free
- **Length:** 20 minutes
- **Book:** https://bodyguiding.as.me/introductory-call

## About the Practitioner

- **Name:** Kamila Moravcová
- **Credentials:** MSc Physiotherapy, Charles University, Prague
- **Clinical practice since:** 2008
- **Background:** Interdisciplinary psychosomatic setting; close cooperation with psychotherapist Jana Zajícová (psychotherapy with the assistance of horses); focus on women's health; teaches and works with physiotherapists and movement practitioners
- **Influences:** Functional approach of Clara Lewitová; fascia; integral anatomy; biotensegrity (central lens since 2020)
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/kamila_inpractice/
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/kamila-moravcov%C3%A1-12b44571/
